title: Lean Canonical Ledger Summary

canonical_node.axiom: Each unique theorem or declaration name in the Lean scan has exactly one canonical owner, and the public proof count must derive only from canonical theorems that compile.
definitions: canonical_theorem_count_pending_compile: number of unique theorem names that are not scaffolding and not low-content true, pending compile verification.
scaffolding_excluded: declarations marked as SCAFFOLDING_NOT_PUBLIC_COUNT, not counted as proofs.
low_content_true_excluded: declarations marked as LOW_CONTENT_TRUE_NOT_PUBLIC_COUNT, not counted as proofs.
proof_strength: classification of proof by strength, e.g., TRIVIAL_TRUE, SIMPLIFICATION, DEFINITIONAL_RFL, WRAPPER_OR_IMPORTED, SUBSTANTIVE_OR_CASE_PROOF, FINITE_DECIDABLE.
derivation: Scan 47 Lean files and collect all declaration instances.
Deduplicate by declaration name to obtain unique names.
Classify each unique name by kind and proof strength.
Exclude scaffolding and low-content true declarations from public proof count.
Compute canonical_theorem_count_pending_compile as the remaining unique theorem count.
Note that compile status is pending; no Lean build was run in this pass.
canonical_node.action: Use canonical_theorem_count_pending_compile as the only public proof count, and only after the relevant canonical roots compile.
boundary: Does not claim any theorem is proven; compile status is pending.
Does not publish raw declaration counts as proof counts.
Does not include scaffolding or low-content true declarations in the public proof count.
test: Check that the public proof count equals canonical_theorem_count_pending_compile.
Check that no scaffolding or low-content true declarations are included in the public proof count.
Check that compile status is reported as pending when no Lean build has been run.

dg1_dependencies: Classification of proof strength and public count buckets
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a deduplicated canonical ledger that prevents double-counting and establishes a disciplined public proof count.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the distinction between raw declaration instances and unique canonical theorems, and maintains the exclusion of scaffolding and low-content true declarations.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this ledger, the public proof count would be ambiguous and could incorrectly include scaffolding or low-content true declarations, leading to overcounting.

classification.recommended_atom_action: record as canonical ledger metadata; do not treat as proof of any theorem

overstatement_risks: Claiming that canonical_theorem_count_pending_compile represents proven theorems when compile is pending.
Publishing raw declaration counts as proof counts.
Including scaffolding or low-content true declarations in public proof counts.
kill_conditions: If a canonical theorem fails to compile, the count must be reduced.
If deduplication is incorrect, the ledger is invalid.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the ledger as a data structure in Lean, with functions to compute canonical counts and enforce exclusions.

plain_summary: This document is a meta-ledger that deduplicates Lean declarations and sets rules for what counts as a public proof. It does not prove any theorems; it only organizes the scan results and warns that compile status is pending.
